label: D2 after a1 -> S2 rare transition, previous trial rewarded, late in episode (trials ~65-95)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero at D1/GO). Nearly all mass (99.9%) is on D2 steps where the agent chose a1 and was taken rarely to S2, with the previous trial rewarded (prev_reward==1 covers 100% of mass). This conjunction alone has recall ~1.0 but precision 0.23. The feature is also strongly gated by time in episode: zero activity before trial ~55, peaking at trials 70-89, so restricting to ep_trial 65-95 raises precision to 0.67 (dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.99). All variables are observed at D2 (the choice and reached state are inputs; ep_trial is implicit elapsed time), no future variables. Mostly in windows where S1 is the good state (90% of mass) and value is mid-range (5.2-7.1), but adding good==1 or a value cut did not improve F1 meaningfully. Does not fire on a2 trials, common transitions, a1->S1, or after unrewarded trials. Remaining false positives are qualifying rare a1->S2 events late in the episode where it stays silent; the episode-time dependence suggests a slow hidden-state drift component, so the description is incomplete.
